elements_not_encoded.text: If abdominal aortic aneurysm likely: avoid giving IV fluids even if BP < 90/60 (raising blood pressure may worsen rupture).
If BP < 90/60 or pancreatitis likely, give sodium chloride 0.9% 500mL IV over 30 minutes, repeat until systolic BP > 90. Continue 1L 6 hourly. Stop if breathing
elements_not_encoded.reason: IV fluids for BP < 90/60 or pancreatitis.

elements_not_encoded.text: If infection likely, give ceftriaxone2 1g IV and single dose metronidazole3 400mg orally.
If pain severe, give morphine 5-10mg IM, repeat 4-6 hourly until patient referred, or give diluted morphine4 3-10mg slow IV: start with 3mL IV over 3 minutes. I
